prompt:
UI design mockup of a phone app screen for a model catalogue, portrait. The visual world is a wooden library card catalogue in a reading room, shown with one card pulled out of the drawer.
Layout top to bottom with scale: (1) a slim brass-ruled header with the app name and icon; (2) the dominant element, roughly half the screen: ONE cream index card pulled forward and lit brighter than the others, lying slightly rotated with a real offset shadow, carrying a typed model name 'Claude Opus 5.5' in bold, the id line, a ruled attribute block of four rows (kind, context, licence, rating) with the values right-aligned in a typed column, and at the card's foot two stamped marks: a red 'LIMITED' stamp and a blue 'LIKENESS OK' stamp; (3) behind and below it, the rest of the stack as narrow card edges showing just names and their stamps, in a fanned arrangement; (4) a brass pull handle drawn at the bottom centre with the words 'Take this model to the chat' on a drawer-front plate.
Real content from the app: facet labels "All", "Language", "Image", "Video", "Voice/TTS", "Music", "Text"; filter labels "Likeness", "NSFW", "Native voice" with option text "Allowed (20)", "Open only (6)", "Blocked (21)"; model names "GPT-6 Luna", "Claude Opus 5.5", "Aion 3.5 Mini", "Grok 4.7", "ElevenLabs Music v2", "MiniMax H3 Max". Style: flat vector interface design, oak and brass cabinet framing a warm cream card stock, typed black spec lines, a red rubber stamp for a rating, a blue stamp for a heading, ruled lines, no photograph, no 3D, no glow, no glass.
